stem: Why can a dryback percentage not be interpreted as a universal pass/fail target by itself?
choices: All crops have the same ideal dryback.
Only the clock time since irrigation matters.
Dryback replaces the need to inspect irrigation delivery.
Its meaning depends on crop stage, media, irrigation history, distribution and plant-demand context.
rationale: Root-zone trends are contextual; Technician II must connect the value to media, crop and delivery evidence before recommending action.
